headline: The arm hit the cereal box at 9.2 s: it was on the bench but missing from the planner's scene map.

claims.text: The tray holds nothing; the pill bottle is not in it.
At 9.24 s, during 'carrying it to the tray', the base stopped dead while its command kept moving: tracking error rose to 6.3 deg and its motor current climbed to 1.55 A.

At 9.24 s the arm was touching the cereal box (19 cm tall); the planner's scene map does not list it, so the carry height of 14 cm was planned without it. The workcell log says: "Cereal box added to the bench for the pantry demo. Planner scene map not re-captured."
The run ran out of time. Refuted: the run ended at 10.12 s, inside its 25 s deadline.
The object slipped out of the gripper. Refuted: the gripper held the object at 35.0 deg from 6.12 s until it was told to open at 10.12 s.
The arm moved a different object than the goal named. Refuted: the grasped object is the pill bottle (0.95), the goal's target.
The gripper closed on nothing. Refuted: every grasp stopped on an object.
The planner knew the object but planned too low. Refuted: the cereal box is not in the planner's scene map, so planning height could not account for it.
It was a sensor glitch, not a real contact. Refuted: the base motor current rose 8.3x (to 1.55 A) with the error: the motor was pushing against something real.
Re-capture the planner's scene map whenever the bench changes, or plan carry height from the live camera tracks, not the saved map.

hypotheses.test: Where the camera last saw every object labelled as the target, and whether that is inside the destination zone.
hypotheses.refute_if: No object labelled as the target is inside the destination zone in the last camera frame.
hypotheses.summary: The tray holds nothing; the pill bottle is not in it.
hypotheses.why: decides whether there is a failure to explain

hypotheses.statement: The run ran out of time.
hypotheses.test: Whether the controller hit the goal's deadline before finishing.
hypotheses.refute_if: The run ended before the deadline with no deadline event.
hypotheses.summary: The run ended at 10.12 s, inside its 25 s deadline.

hypotheses.test: Whether a joint stalled (measured speed near zero) while its command kept moving, building tracking error, and whether its motor current rose with it. Lag at high speed builds error too, but the joint keeps moving.
hypotheses.refute_if: No joint stalls with more than 2.5 deg of tracking error while its command is moving.
hypotheses.summary: At 9.24 s, during 'carrying it to the tray', the base stopped dead while its command kept moving: tracking error rose to 6.3 deg and its motor current climbed to 1.55 A.

runs.summary: No joint ever stalled against its command; the largest tracking error was 2.0 deg on the wrist_flex.

hypotheses.statement: The object slipped out of the gripper.
hypotheses.test: After the grasp, whether the fingers (still commanded closed) closed past the object, and whether the object's camera track fell away from the fingertip.
hypotheses.refute_if: The gripper opening stays at the object's width from the grasp until the gripper is commanded open.
hypotheses.summary: The gripper held the object at 35.0 deg from 6.12 s until it was told to open at 10.12 s.

hypotheses.statement: The arm moved a different object than the goal named.
hypotheses.test: Which camera track was in the fingers at the grasp, and what perception called it at close range.
hypotheses.refute_if: The grasped track's confident label is the goal's target.
hypotheses.summary: The grasped object is the pill bottle (0.95), the goal's target.

hypotheses.test: Whether a grasp closed the fingers fully (below 3 deg) right after reaching for the object.
hypotheses.refute_if: Every grasp stopped on an object (opening above 3 deg).
hypotheses.summary: Every grasp stopped on an object.

hypotheses.statement: Something the planner did not know about was in the arm's path.
hypotheses.test: Which camera-tracked object was touching the arm at the moment of contact, and whether the planner's scene map lists it.
hypotheses.refute_if: No tracked object is within 3 cm of the arm at contact, or the one that is appears in config.planner_objects.
hypotheses.summary: At 9.24 s the arm was touching the cereal box (19 cm tall); the planner's scene map does not list it, so the carry height of 14 cm was planned without it. The workcell log says: "Cereal box added to the bench for the pantry demo. Planner scene map not re-captured."

hypotheses.statement: The planner knew the object but planned too low.
hypotheses.test: Whether the object at the contact point is listed in config.planner_objects.
hypotheses.refute_if: The object at contact is missing from the planner's scene map (then the plan never had a chance).
hypotheses.summary: The cereal box is not in the planner's scene map, so planning height could not account for it.

hypotheses.statement: It was a sensor glitch, not a real contact.
hypotheses.test: Whether motor current rose together with the tracking error (a glitch moves the reading without adding load).
hypotheses.refute_if: Motor current on the lagging joint rose to at least 1.5x its median during the error.
hypotheses.summary: The base motor current rose 8.3x (to 1.55 A) with the error: the motor was pushing against something real.
